tabs.$description: Tokens of `tabs`: its list of tabs and its panels. The tabs take those of `tab`.

border-width.$description: Width of the line under the list of tabs, or beside it when vertical.

border-color.$description: Color of the line under the list of tabs.

panel-padding.$description: Space between the list of tabs and the panel.

text-color.$description: Text color of the tabs and panels.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Space between the element and its focus ring.

scroll-button-size.$description: Width of a scroll button, shown when the tabs go past an edge.

chevron-size.$description: Width and height of the chevron of a scroll button.

chevron-width.$description: Stroke of the chevron. Twice this width.
